layoutApproach: Three-column reading: left TOC/outline (collapsible) + center content (per-type renderer) + right rail. The right column hosts the feedback/review panel and the agent panel as MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE (one occupancy). Bottom action rail carries file ops (location=return-to-manager, export, download, rename, move, extract, share, delete).

responsive.mobile: Content-first single column; TOC and feedback hide as slide-in overlays; feedback via floating button + bottom panel; btnPath/back visible; 4-col collapses to 1.
responsive.tablet: TOC (240px) + content; feedback/agent as slide-in drawer; bottombar scrolls horizontally.
responsive.desktop: 3-4 column; feedback and agent share single right column exclusively; bottombar full width.

interactionMap.file selection: open feedback tooltip (add todo / submit review)
interactionMap.btnPath(位置): jump to file directory in File Manager (return entry)
interactionMap.feedbackCard: editable pending card / read-only submitted card
interactionMap.agentPanel: open terminal/chat, exclusive with feedback panel
